description: Work out the distribution rules for an inherited IRA under the SECURE Act final regulations (T.D. 10001) and IRS Pub. 590-B: the beneficiary class (eligible designated, designated or non-designated), whether the owner died before or after the required beginning date, the rule that applies (life expectancy, 10-year with or without annual RMDs, 5-year), the deadline to empty the account, this year's required minimum from the Single Life Expectancy Table, and four ways to drain it (back-loaded, even, front-loaded, fill a bracket) compared on federal tax in 2026 dollars and after-tax value. No names or account numbers are needed.

balance.description: Account balance on December 31 of the prior year.

beneficiaryBirthYear.description: Beneficiary's birth year (not needed for non_designated).

beneficiaryClass.description: spouse = Surviving spouse; minor_child = Owner’s child under 21; disabled = Disabled; chronically_ill = Chronically ill; close_in_age = Not more than 10 years younger than the owner; designated = Other person (designated beneficiary); non_designated = Estate, charity or non-qualifying trust.

electTenYear.description: Eligible beneficiary elected the 10-year rule (owner died before the required beginning date).

fillRate.description: Bracket to fill each year in the fill strategy (default 24).

otherIncome.description: Beneficiary's other ordinary income per year (default 0).

ownerDeathDate.description: Owner's date of death, YYYY-MM-DD (or a year).

realReturn.description: Annual return after inflation in percent (default 0).

roth.description: True for an inherited Roth IRA.

stateTaxRate.description: Flat state tax rate in percent (default 0).

name: inherited_ira_plan
title: Inherited IRA plan
